profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I'm a software engineer with experience working on real-time tracking systems, hardware integrations, and developer tools for computer vision tracking. I enjoy building systems that connect software and hardware, and I try to stay dependable, focused, and open to learning.

Earlier in my career, I worked in technical support and documentation, and I’ve also worked in environments focused on supporting people with disabilities and accessibility needs. Those experiences gave me a deeper appreciation for user needs and accessibility, and they continue to shape how I approach design, communication, and building software that truly works for people.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led development of a head-tracking application used in gaming simulations and assistive technology, focusing on accuracy and real-time performance.
• Developed plugin integrations for third-party finger-tracking gloves, using external SDKs and extending the external device API to support new device data and features.
• Maintained and enhanced the MotionBuilder plugin to support evolving user needs in retargeting workflows and integrate new system capabilities.
• Contributed to testing, maintenance, and feature development as part of the core engineering team across multiple releases of the motion capture system.

positions.title: Technical Support Engineer / Technical Writer
positions.description:
• Created and managed both internal and external documentation, including user documentation, developer guides, and SDK/API references.
• Led the overhaul of the company’s online documentation platform using MediaWiki, PHP, JavaScript, MySQL, HTML/CSS; resulting in 10x increase in daily traffic by adding concise and informative user guides.
• Supported customers and partners with integration, application engineering, and troubleshooting across film, VR, animation, sports, and healthcare domains.
• Trained new users and developers on system setup, API usage, and client-side integration techniques.

positions.title: Student Researcher
positions.description: • Designed and led a research project modeling patellofemoral joint behavior in pathological gaits and in braced conditions; presented findings at the American Society of Biomechanics conference.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Developed MATLAB tools to build biomechanical models from motion capture data and analyze upper and lower body movement patterns.
• Applied motion analysis results to optimize waveforms for functional electrical stimulation (FES) in rehabilitation control systems.
